name: JelloDog Chat
tagline: Chat for servers friends DMs and voice
blurb: JelloDog Chat is an open source chat system for communities and friends.
description:
JelloDog Chat is an open source chat system for communities and friends.

Features:

- Servers and channels
- Direct messages
- Friend requests
- Voice channels
- Screen sharing
- Roles and moderation tools
- Attachments
- Admin tools
- Self-hostable server URL support

The Android build is prepared for F-Droid distribution without Google Play Services, Firebase, or remote CDN JavaScript. JelloDog Chat is licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later.

Source code:
https://github.com/JelloDog-Applications/JelloChat-electron
